text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] prefill_gpu_oom detected in pool=nyc-gpu, service=redwood-serving (severity=high). 8 container restarts in the past 5m. Links: https://redwood/alerts/4610000000 :rotating_light:

carla (oncall): I'm paged, looking now. Paging runtime and SRE. @ben (runtime) @maria (sre) pls join.

ben (runtime): saw the alert. copying logs. most restarts show OOM during prefill for large-context requests (~>200k tokens). containers exit code=137 then kube restarts.

ben (runtime): log snippet:
```
2026-01-12T21:13:02Z ERROR prefill_worker: CUDA error at /srv/runtime/kv_cache.cu:344: out of memory
stack: serving::prefill(...)
container 874f1a exit status 137
```

maria (sre): node metrics show GPU memory pinned, fragmentation spike. node=nyc-gpu-07. kernel logs show no driver reset but high GPU mem usage. No host OOM killer.

eve (ml-eng): model=redwood-14b-rc quantized int8, target sequence len 262k for that request (customer long form import). Prefill alloc attempts for full seq and KV cache growth causes whole-GPU allocation and fragmentation. We've seen similar but not at this scale.

carla (oncall): customers impacted? @dave (cust-succ) any inbound tickets?

dave (cust-succ): AcmeCorp reported timeouts on ingestion pipeline, BetaApps edge cases too. Both correlate with 21:11-21:18 window. I'm drafting a customer update. low confidence on percentage impacted yet.

ben (runtime): temporary mitigation proposals:
- enable prefill truncation to 64k tokens for the hosted pool (safety hammer)
- route requests with sequence_len > 64k to coldmodel (disk-backed) variant
- reduce max concurrent prefill on affected nodes (soft limit)
- restart pod on node-07 after draining to recover fragmentation

maria (sre): agree. I'll cordon and drain node=nyc-gpu-07 and move non-critical pods off. Running: `kubectl drain nyc-gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

infra-bot: DRY-RUN: cordon OK, moving 12 pods. No PVs impacted.

carla (oncall): ben, can you flip truncation and routing? If we can avoid a full node restart that's preferable. Also add a short TTL for cache entries.

ben (runtime): On it. Applying route config change via admin API.
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.internal/v1/admin/route-config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"pool":"nyc-gpu","prefill_truncate":64000,"route_large_to":"coldmodel","kv_ttl_s":30}'
```

ben (runtime): PATCH returned 200. Rolling new runtime config to pool-nyc-gpu.

infra-bot: Restarting 3 runtime pods on nyc-gpu-07 as part of rolling config.

ben (runtime): Also applied a temporary per-account context limit to prevent new >100k requests hitting hosted API:
```bash
# temp rate-limit rule
curl -X POST https://console.internal/v1/admin/limits -d '{"type":"context_limit","max_tokens":100000,"scope":"hosted","ttl":3600}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

eve (ml-eng): Noted. We'll follow up with a model-side fallback to incremental prefill (streamed KV build) — longer-term fix.

maria (sre): Node drained, restarted pods. Post-change metrics show GPU mem tail usage dropped and no further restarts in the last 6m. nyc-gpu-07 marked schedulable again.

dave (cust-succ): sending a short customer note: "We're investigating increased errors for long-context uploads; mitigation applied to limit extreme sessions and reduce restarts. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause." Will post to AcmeCorp, BetaApps now.

carla (oncall): Excellent. Quick checklist for incident timeline and severity:
- 21:10 alert -> initial pages (incident-bot)
- 21:12 runtime triage -> found OOMs on prefill for long-context (>200k)
- 21:16 config mitigations applied (prefill_truncate, route_large_to coldmodel, context limit)
- 21:22 node drain/restart and pod rolling complete
- 21:29 restarts stopped; services stable

ben (runtime): open actions:
- follow-up: implement streaming prefill fallback (eve)
- follow-up: add eviction/fragmentation monitor and automated soft-evict when fragmentation>70% (maria/infra)
- follow-up: update runbook prefill OOM with new mitigations and example admin API calls (carla/ben)

carla (oncall): assigning follow-ups in the incident ticket 2026-4610000000. I'll hand off to next oncall @maria (sre) for overnight watch.

maria (sre): taking handoff. I've set alert threshold to severity=critical only for the night and extended retention on logs for 48h.

dave (cust-succ): posted customer update and scheduled a follow-up call with AcmeCorp tomorrow 10am PT.

ben (runtime): quick note — container exit codes and OOM stack traces saved to /var/log/incidents/4610000000.log and attached to ticket.

carla (oncall): thanks everyone. Closing the pager. Will run a blameless postmortem tomorrow during oncall overlap. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident 4610000000 status=mitigated. Postmortem link to be created when triage complete."
